upstream_notices:
MangaWeb uses KOReader public interfaces. The full-screen reader input and close model derives from WebDAVManga ui_reader_shell.lua. The standalone panel core was initially copied from WebDAVManga v0.4.21 (567002ce1d53e45f35020c849125fe7ef0fd2f20) with its internal module namespace changed. MangaWeb subsequently added independent recognition tuning and safe redetection; the original WebDAVManga plugin is not modified. Initial copy hashes and later adaptations are recorded in docs/provenance/webdav-panels.json. Site content and image copyrights belong to their respective owners.

Panel component detection and geometry contain adapted code from PanelsPlus,
revision 14c53e9daec5a34e627dddb3bd52483ddb787bad:
https://github.com/KristanLaimon/PanelsPlus
Changes: bounded host/native arrays, fitted ordering frames separated from
protected display bounds, deterministic ties, plugin-owned coverage checks.
